camp: A safe zone before entering the tower.
dungeons: First floor of the tower. Undead prisoners and guards await!
goblin caves: Second floor of the tower. A labyrinth of stones filled with hostile creatures.
arcane academy: Third floor of the tower. An abandoned wizard academy now home to various evil creatures.
unarmed: Increase damage with unarmed abilities and non human attacks.
blade: Increase minimum damage with bladed weapons.
blunt: Increase minimum damage with blunt weapons.
dagger: Increase backstab damage with daggers by 3.
bow: Increase damage with weapons that use arrows.
firearm: Increase damage with weapons that use bullets.
ambush: Reduce enemy sight angle by 5 degrees.
evocation: Increase damage with magical artifacts. Increase max mana.
aura: Increase max mana. Scale aura abilities.
psych: Increase max mana. Scale psychic abilities.
earth: Increase max mana. Scale earth based abilities.
necromancy: Increase max mana. Scale necromantic abilities.
tip_warrior: Weapons can't hit enemies directly in front of them. Pushing them right before swinging will do the trick. Even better is swinging right sideways, which can also cleave.
tip_scholar: There are multiple essences that get triggered same way. For example, passwall and psychic blast both trigger from using bare hands. Choose your essence wisely.
tip_rogue: Killing townsfolk and animals on camp won't give you any experience.
tip_hunter: There are essences for each weapon proficiencies that are very helpful. The elven essence for example, will give you infinite arrows.
tip_barbarian: There are some cursed weapons that imbue good enchantments on the enemy when you hit them.
tip_druid: Polymorph is useful, but they get even stronger with higher Unarmed and Armor proficiency levels.
tip_necromancer: There are many essence that generate health and mana. With the right combination, you can become invincible!
tip_priestess: Whenever you make some money, make sure to get the revival blessing from the chaplain. It lasts until you die.
tip_trainer: My favorite capture so far is the crusader.
tip_crusader: Did you know that your mana refills to maximum each time you return to camp?
Peasant: What the hell is this guy doing here?
Warrior: Masters of the blade, they tackle problems in the head.
Scholar: Wandering in search of essence, their power will scale with wealth.
Rogue: With the element of first strike, they strike their victims down with ease.
Hunter: Armed with a ranged weapon, they are versatile predators.
Barbarian: They tank their way into the dungeons with high vitality.
Druid: Being able to shapeshift at will puts them at an advantage even in times of danger.
Necromancer: They dominate the battlefield with powerful undead allies, and have access to useful necromantic essence later on.
Priestess: Sustainance in both group and solo setting make them invaluable in any group.
Trainer: Aiming to be the very best, trainers turn the fallen enemies against their own.
Crusader: On a divine quest to eradicate lepers, crusaders are merciless killing machines.
